records.grammarDefinition: 既有结构在新条件下重新组织。

domainTests.evidenceTest: Evidence must directly support formation, initialization, activation, establishment, or structural coming-into-being; a current state or date alone is insufficient.
domainTests.missing: Formation/activation of a newly organized structure is not separately admitted.

domainTests.evidenceTest: Evidence must directly support ongoing operation, routing, functioning, coordination, load, exchange, or active runtime relationships in an already operating system; currentness alone is insufficient.
domainTests.missing: Revenue totals and reporting labels do not establish operation, routing or coordination of the reorganized structure.

domainTests.evidenceTest: Evidence must directly support persistence, maintenance, recovery, calibration, governance, adaptation across time, or continuity of an established system; longevity alone is insufficient.
domainTests.missing: The admitted event statement does not independently establish governance, adaptation, maintenance or continuity mechanisms across time.

missingEvidence: New conditions explicitly linked to the reported organizational change.
Direct evidence for one canonical domain test at the same bounded subsystem scope.
records.boundedReading: The issuer reports a historical segment-composition change. Full G14 and P1/P2/P3 qualification is not established.
